enso.name: NOAA CPC Relative Oceanic Niño Index (RONI)
enso.licence: US government public data; credit NOAA CPC
enso.cadence: Monthly; latest estimates may be revised
enso.limitation: Three-month relative sea-surface temperature anomaly (ERSSTv6); period is the central month of the season. Not a country-specific rainfall or yield forecast.

climate.name: NASA POWER monthly point API
climate.licence: NASA open data; credit NASA POWER / MERRA-2
climate.cadence: Monthly; recent months may be preliminary
climate.limitation: Illustrative grid-cell locations, not crop-weighted national indicators. Temperature and mean daily precipitation rate versus same-month 1991–2020 mean (at least 24 years). No drought classification or yield inference.

domestic.name: WFP market prices via HDX CKAN API
domestic.limitation: Six purposively selected pilot countries. Actual retail quotations, original product variant, market, currency and unit; up to five recent market series per product per country. No national average, no currency conversion. Dataset-specific attribution licence checked before publication.
